newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-OSCAR SCHINDLER TO RUN IN MELBOURNE CUP.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-OSCAR SCHINDLER TO RUN IN MELBOURNE CUP.

text.p: Oscar Schindler, a fast-finishing third to Helissio in last Sunday's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, will run in next month's Melbourne Cup.

Michael Kinane, the Irish jockey, who partnered Vintage Crop to his historic victory at Flemington in 1993, has convinced owner Oliver Lehane that he will never have a better chance of landing Australia's greatest horse race.
Oscar Schinder, the Irish St Leger winner and also victorious at Royal Ascot, looks well handicapped, and will join English raiders Court Of Honour and Grey Shot in the November 5 race.
Although trainer Kevin Prendergast was keen to run, owner Lehane had grave reservations about embarking on a trip that will set him back about 50,000 pounds ($78,000).
But he said on Thursday: "It was Mick Kinane who finally persuaded me and he will ride Oscar Schindler in the race."
Oscar Schindler has been cut to 5-1 favourite from 7-1 by bookmakers Coral. "The horse couldn't be better and he has a real chance in the race," said Prendergast, who was born in Melbourne.
